calibration_procedure: 1. Freeze the accepted pairs and their scale/boundary metadata above.
2. Emit all raw component metrics before choosing thresholds (score_preservation's metric dict).

3. Set thresholds no tighter than the worst accepted result plus margin (see D5Thresholds defaults in scripts/gates/d5_preservation.py and the PASS/FAIL table in tasks/transparent-bg-endgame/CALIBRATION.md).
4. Require every synthetic deletion mutation in tests/test_d5_preservation.py to exit non-PASS (REVIEW for fine components, FAIL for anchor/skeleton/island violations).
5. Refuse threshold changes unless accepted outputs above remain non-FAIL and all blocking mutations still FAIL.
